players.product: Sqale neutral-atom quantum computer (plus quantum clocks and RF sensors)

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Matt Kinsella: in May the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a letter of intent providing for up to $100 million in proposed funding for Infleqtion. CFO Ilan Hart: Infleqtion expects to complete the definitive agreement process later this year; under the current structure it expects up to $100 million to be recorded as other income that offsets eligible operating expenses, with the final treatment depending on the definitive agreement and the applicable accounting review.
quarterly_data.figure: up to $100 million proposed Department of Commerce funding (letter of intent)

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Ilan Hart: Infleqtion ended Q2 2026 with approximately $582 million in cash, cash equivalents and available-for-sale securities, with no debt.
quarterly_data.figure: ~$582 million cash, cash equivalents and available-for-sale securities; no debt
